title: goFlux (Rheault et al. 2024), fork with additions
description: Fork of the goFlux R package (Rheault et al. 2024; Qepanna/goFlux 0.5.0, commit 3ab9c04) with additions for chamber-flux methods: empirical second-difference precision, closure duration from the logging interval, detection classes relative to the minimal detectable flux, post-hoc quality flags, window and clock utilities, a one-call pipeline, de-ebulliated diffusive fluxes for floating chambers, and example closures. goFlux itself is by K. Rheault, C. Minaudo, K. S. Larsen and contributors; cite the goFlux paper (doi:10.21105/joss.06393) together with this record. See NEWS.md for the additions.
